shortdesc: Custom and ranked Cups with matchmaking, Discord accounts, friends, ratings and match history.

changelogs.0.2.24: Background-tab recovery rebuilds Cup channels and keeps automatic rounds pending while a racer reconnects.
changelogs.0.3.0: Preset checkbox for native Casual mode and leaderboard uploads, with session-only record saving when disabled. Lobby connection indicators and host kick controls, animated rankings, PB/TR/WR record tabs, and a preset rename button. Cup chat with saved history, username colors, name-click mute controls and slur filtering. Late round starts count toward Cup time. Custom tracks are disabled when bans are enabled. Streamlined lobby controls with editable preset names and automatic rule updates. Customizable Standard and Quickplay presets, preset import/export, fixed rounds per track, optional custom tracks and mid-Cup racer changes. Automatic racer recovery, start respawns with cumulative timing, held inputs and camera choice across rounds, continuous spectator handoffs, pending action feedback, and multiplayer version checks.
changelogs.0.3.1: Track removal with score rollback, spectator freecam and viewer counts, and host-only physics warnings. Unified fixed-height lobby with inline preset editing, embedded chat, simpler player controls and lighter labels. Fixed setup disconnects and duplicate racers, rapid checkpoint-reset DNFs, rematch setup, preset icons and lingering notices. Removed tournament/review exports, separate organizer screens and the spectator dropdown; preset sharing and local autosaves remain.
changelogs.0.3.2: Fixed split-update stutters in longer Cups, missing last-checkpoint splits (including single-checkpoint tracks such as Desert 3), stale TR/WR badges after faster finishes, and chat scrolling when switching lobby tabs. Record badges now slide back under racer cards. Improved finish delivery under high latency and packet backlogs. Removed Cup autosaves, restoration, and player-management arrows from final results.
changelogs.0.3.3:
- **Added**: Draft ready-up with locked picks and a cancellable five-second countdown announced in chat.
- **Added**: Host “Return to lobby” control to reset drafting without recreating the Cup or losing its roster and chat.
- **Added**: Preset overwrite confirmation, undo for deleted presets, and clearer validation messages.
- **Added**: Chat unread markers, new-message counts and a jump to the latest messages.
- **Changed**: More compact player cards with inline status, connection icons beside names, and clear ready/banning highlights.
- **Changed**: Reserved ban/pick slots with gray placeholders, smooth fill animations and polished hover effects.
- **Changed**: Click selected tracks to unpick them; additional choices are disabled when all pick slots are filled.
- **Changed**: Moved draft rules into the topbar Rules button and gave the track browser more space.
- **Changed**: Wider live rankings with less wasted space for longer names, without shrinking the font.
- **Changed**: Slim scrollbars throughout PolyCup, smoother pop-up/menu transitions and clearer spectator-switching feedback.
- **Fixed**: Track thumbnails being cropped or blurred by excessive scaling.
- **Fixed**: Player menus losing their position when scrolling or resizing, with improved focus and scroll preservation during UI updates.
- **Removed**: Redundant draft headings, separate pick-summary screens and the between-round “Up next” pop-up.
changelogs.0.4.0:
- **Added**: Main-menu Cup browser, private lobbies, Discord sign-in with automatic return, friends and invitations.
- **Added**: Ranked matchmaking with accept/decline, fixed drafts, persistent ratings, rank badges, leaderboards and public match history.
- **Added**: Two-minute ranked reconnect grace, explicit abandonment and reliable rating results, including notifications after reopening the game.
- **Added**: Background input comparison with public Possible copied inputs detected flags.
- **Improved**: Cup transitions, draft feedback, personal-best tracking, post-Cup rejoining and consistent social UI.
- **Fixed**: Early keyboard input during mod startup.
